page_title: SAS 0-3 JUV | Sassuolo v Juventus 06/01/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+3' Andrea Pinamonti (Sassuolo) is flagged for offside.
90+2' Josh Doig (Sassuolo) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
90+1' Sassuolo take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
90' There will be a minimum of 3 min. of added time.
90' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Edon Zhegrova (Juventus) comes onto the pitch for Fabio Miretti.
90' Substitution. Sebastian Walukiewicz makes his way off the pitch and Cas Odenthal (Sassuolo) comes on as his replacement.
86' Sebastian Walukiewicz (Sassuolo) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.
85' Luciano Spalletti has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Juan Cabal (Juventus) replacing Andrea Cambiaso.
85' Kenan Yildiz goes off the pitch and Vasilije Adzic (Juventus) comes on.
84' Sassuolo can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

83' Luca Lipani (Sassuolo) beats his marker and unleashes a thunderbolt of a shot from the edge of the box. Michele Di Gregorio sees the ball late but does well to stop it going inside the right post.
81' Lois Openda (Juventus) makes a slide tackle, but referee Luca Zufferli blows for a foul.
80' Josh Doig (Sassuolo) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
77' It is time for a substitution. Nicholas Pierini (Sassuolo) is on for Armand Lauriente.
77' Substitution. Edoardo Iannoni did his best and is replaced by Aster Vranckx (Sassuolo).
76' The substitution has been made. Luca Lipani (Sassuolo) has replaced Nemanja Matic.
75' Luciano Spalletti has decided to make a change. Joao Mario (Juventus) replaces Weston McKennie.
75' The referee allows time for a substitution. Jonathan David will be replaced by Lois Openda (Juventus).
74' Teun Koopmeiners (Juventus) works the corner short.
74' Khephren Thuram (Juventus) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. The ball goes out for a corner. Juventus can continue in their attacking effort.
72' Teun Koopmeiners (Juventus) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.
70' Some patient build-up play from Sassuolo as they look to unlock the defence.
67' Jonathan David (Juventus) slips past a defender on the edge of the box and hits a shot at goal that rises just over the bar.
63' 0 - 3 Jonathan David (Juventus) gets one-on-one with the goalkeeper and takes an early shot which finds the back of the net.
62' Goal - 0:3! Jonathan David tees up Fabio Miretti (Juventus) inside the box and he curls the ball into the left side of the net and past Arijanet Muric.
61' Ismael Kone (Sassuolo) trips an opposition player and Luca Zufferli signals a foul.

59' Ambitious effort from Fabio Miretti (Juventus). He finds himself in a great position after collecting a precise pass inside the penalty area and goes for goal, but it never troubles the goalkeeper and flies well over the bar.
57' The corner is swung in but Sassuolo can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
55' Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
53' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Kenan Yildiz (Juventus).

53' The referee blows his whistle, Juventus are awarded a corner kick. Khephren Thuram (Juventus) collects a great pass inside the box and misses a golden opportunity. His low drive is headed for the bottom left corner, but the goalkeeper pulls off a marvellous diving save and denies him.
49' Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) launches a cross from the corner, but Arijanet Muric is alert to thwart the effort.
48' Luca Zufferli couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Manuel Locatelli (Juventus) and blew his whistle.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+4' Luca Zufferli blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+2' Arijanet Muric is alert and has a clear sight of a long through ball from Khephren Thuram (Juventus). Easy save!
45' 3 additional min. will be played.
41' A snap shot by Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) from the edge of the area flies towards the top left corner, but Arijanet Muric produces a good save to thwart him.
39' Kristian Thorstvedt is being substituted because of an injury. Fabio Grosso sends Alieu Fadera (Sassuolo) on the pitch.
37' Kristian Thorstvedt (Sassuolo) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
36' Pierre Kalulu (Juventus) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Luca Zufferli blows for a foul.
35' Manuel Locatelli (Juventus) latches on to a precise pass on the edge of the box, but miskicks his shot and the ball goes high over the bar. Poor effort!
34' Juventus seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
33' The resulting corner from Teun Koopmeiners (Juventus) is cleared.
31' Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) steadies himself and bends in a shot from the edge of the box towards the top of the net, but Arijanet Muric has it covered and makes a comfortable save.
29' A pass from Weston McKennie (Juventus) is intercepted by Arijanet Muric and the move breaks down.
27' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Khephren Thuram (Juventus) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
26' A raking crossfield pass from Ismael Kone (Sassuolo) lacks accuracy and the opposition gain possession.

24' Jonathan David (Juventus) receives a precise pass and is given time inside the box to send a promising strike towards the middle of the goal. Arijanet Muric guesses his intention and denies him with a fine save.
23' Kristian Thorstvedt (Sassuolo) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
22' Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
19' Pierre Kalulu (Juventus) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
16' 0 - 1 It's an own goal! An unlucky moment for Tarik Muharemovic (Sassuolo), who tries to clear a cross into the six-yard box but heads the ball behind his own keeper. The score is 0:1.
15' Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) sends a screamer well wide of the right post from the edge of the box.
13' Teun Koopmeiners (Juventus) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.

12' Khephren Thuram (Juventus) wasted a huge opportunity! The fans already began to celebrate as he produced a shot from the edge of the box after a brilliant solo effort. The ball went towards the bottom left corner, but Arijanet Muric made an astonishing save!
12' Kristian Thorstvedt (Sassuolo) sends a quick through ball into space for his teammate who is lurking close to the offside line, but one of the defenders intercepts and clears the danger.
10' Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus) is furious with himself as he misses a golden opportunity from inside the six-yard box. He sends a rebound a few inches wide of the left post.
10' Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) produced a promising shot towards the bottom left corner after his wonderful solo run, but Arijanet Muric thwarted him with a fabulous save and the score remains the same.
6' A lofted cross from Pierre Kalulu (Juventus) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
4' Sebastian Walukiewicz (Sassuolo) goes for goal but he directs his effort just wide of the left post.
2' Sassuolo failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
2' The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Sassuolo. Josh Doig (Sassuolo) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
Juventus will kick the game off.
Luca Zufferli is the one to supervise the game today.
